$comment: Scoped permission profile for autonomous-backlog.sh. Loaded via `claude --settings`. It pre-allows the safe commands an unattended worker needs and denies the irreversible ones, so a supervised-autonomous run proceeds without prompts while the void security hooks (protect-sensitive-files, block-dangerous-bash) remain the non-skippable deny floor. Tune `allow` to your project's real toolchain; never widen `deny`. See ../SKILL.md (Safety).
